capabilities: Format existing links into bookmarks with favicon and title
Create bookmark grid views from website links
Cache looked-up titles and icons in a vault folder
disambiguation: Not just a display tweak; it rewrites the link's Markdown so the icon is inlined as text, keeping the link portable.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13+; formatted links become very long in Source mode (~1,300–4,800 characters per icon); a free Bookmarkify token is needed once; nothing is sent online until you click Format.
problem: Obsidian shows pasted URLs as plain text, so getting a recognizable title and icon for each link means editing the Markdown by hand.

relations.evidence: Titles come from a small online service, Bookmarkify, so you need a free token once

summary: Converts bare web links into bookmark-style Markdown links showing the site's favicon and title, and builds bookmark grid views.
